Generate an acceptance signing identity for the validation transcript and report, plus a separate control identity for the source manifest.

Produce `/testbed/transformers-candidates-report.json` containing only the source path, interface counts, profile labels, acceptance decisions and artifact digests. Sign and submit it through the supplied loopback gateway with the engineer publication credential and perform an independent review. Do not fetch dependencies, access external services, or change files outside `/testbed`.
I will inspect the Transformers candidate generation source surface and repository state.
